component.name: EverEye
component.summary: Keep your Linux work awake with a bounded timer

description.p: Keep long-running tasks moving with timed awake sessions, optional lid-switch inhibition, battery safeguards and temporary power-saver requests.

EverEye provides a native dashboard, tray and command line. Sessions end automatically and interrupted sessions release their holds. A logind-compatible service, a user D-Bus session and supported Linux process supervision are required. UPower provides battery protection.
